agenda_text:
AGENDA
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL

  1225 North Hacienda Road
  La Habra Heights, California

  4:00 p.m. Closed Session
  6:00 p.m. Regular Business

  December 12, 2013
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you
require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s
office at (562) 694-6302.

Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk’s Office at 1225 N.
Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Public comments on action items on the agenda (except public hearings) and matters not on
the agenda but within the purview of the City Council will be heard toward the beginning of
each regular meeting. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled
on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future
agenda.

To speak in the Public Comments segment please complete a speaker’s card and hand it to
the City Manager/City Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the
podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Each speaker is limited to one
five-minute period on items as described above. To speak during a public hearing, please
provide a Speaker’s Card listing that agenda item by number and submit it before the hearing
is opened to the public. Your speaking time during a public hearing will be limited to three
minutes and to the purpose of the public hearing. Should you need to provide written
documentation, please give the City Manager/City Clerk a minimum of NINE (9) copies prior
to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed prior to the comment period.

If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only
those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in
written correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Gov.
Code 65009(b)(2).)

  VIEW THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING LIVE AT: WWW.LHHCITY.ORG
